palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization.

Here's an example of a palindrome:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam"

This is a 26-character palindrome in English. However, if we are to generate a longer palindrome, it would be:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba."

This is a well-known palindrome and is considered the longest palindrome phrase when counting spaces.

If you want a numerical palindrome, one that reads the same forward and backward, here's an example of a 3-digit number palindrome: 121.
